spots.name: Sioux Strip State Wildlife Management Area
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Council Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 567 m (1,860 ft).

spots.name: Gavins Point
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing south. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
